local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeSigns")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="UpgradeSigns";folder.Parent=world

local upgrades={
 {key="SpeedLevel",title="SPEED",sub="Move Faster",base=15},
 {key="WorthLevel",title="ENERGY WORTH",sub="Orbs Give More",base=25},
 {key="AmountLevel",title="ENERGY AMOUNT",sub="More Orbs Spawn",base=35}
}

local function cost(data,level) return data.base*(level+1) end

local function makeSign(number,z,data)
 local x=-21
 local post=Instance.new("Part");post.Name=data.key.."Post";post.Size=Vector3.new(1,5,1);post.Position=Vector3.new(x,22.5,z);post.Anchored=true;post.Color=Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43);post.Material=Enum.Material.Wood;post.Parent=folder
 local board=Instance.new("Part");board.Name=data.key.."Sign";board.Size=Vector3.new(.7,5,9);board.Position=Vector3.new(x,26,z);board.Anchored=true;board.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,54,66);board.Material=Enum.Material.Slate;board.Parent=folder
 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Right;gui.Parent=board
 local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Name="UpgradeText";text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;text.TextWrapped=true;text.TextScaled=true;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,120);text.Parent=gui
 local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");prompt.ActionText="Buy Upgrade";prompt.ObjectText=data.title;prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.2;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=board

 local function refresh(player)
  local level=player:FindFirstChild(data.key)
  local lv=level and level.Value or 0
  text.Text=data.title.."\nLevel "..lv.."\n"..cost(data,lv).." Energy"
  prompt.ActionText="Buy - "..cost(data,lv).." Energy"
 end

 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
  local level=player:FindFirstChild(data.key)
  if not energy or not level then return end
  local price=cost(data,level.Value)
  if energy.Value<price then return end
  energy.Value-=price
  level.Value+=1
  if data.key=="SpeedLevel" and player.Character then
   local hum=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if hum then hum.WalkSpeed=16+(level.Value*2) end
  end
  refresh(player)
 end)

 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
  task.wait(1)
  refresh(player)
 end)
end

makeSign(1,-11,upgrades[1])
makeSign(2,0,upgrades[2])
makeSign(3,11,upgrades[3])
print("Purchasable upgrades loaded")

changes.name: UpgradePlayerSetup
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local function setup(player)
 for _,name in ipairs({"SpeedLevel","WorthLevel","AmountLevel"}) do
  if not player:FindFirstChild(name) then
   local v=Instance.new("IntValue");v.Name=name;v.Value=0;v.Parent=player
  end
 end
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
  local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
  local speed=player:WaitForChild("SpeedLevel")
  hum.WalkSpeed=16+(speed.Value*2)
 end)
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setup(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)

changes.name: UpgradeModifiers
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local function hookOrb(orb)
 if not orb:IsA("BasePart") or orb.Name~="EnergyOrb" then return end
 local claimed=false
 orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if claimed or not orb.Parent then return end
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not player then return end
  local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
  local worth=player:FindFirstChild("WorthLevel")
  if not energy or not worth then return end
  claimed=true
  local bonus=worth.Value
  if bonus>0 then energy.Value+=bonus end
 end)
end
for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do hookOrb(v) end
world.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) task.wait();hookOrb(v) end)

task.spawn(function()
 while world.Parent do
  local best=0
  for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local a=p:FindFirstChild("AmountLevel")
   if a then best=math.max(best,a.Value) end
  end
  if best>0 then
   -- Extra-orb upgrade shortens orb lifetime turnover, causing more frequent new spawns.
   for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name=="EnergyOrb" and math.random()<math.min(.04*best,.3) then v:Destroy() end
   end
  end
  task.wait(2)
 end
end)
